title: 第21章 银河谷第22章 夜战
content_zh:
“不对劲啊，这好好的，突然把我调走，而且还是在刚刚得罪赵锐凌的节骨眼上……。”
刘知虎离开后，韩林站在石屋中眉头紧紧皱起，直觉告诉他，这里面很有问题。
至于刘知虎说的由头，在他看来，更像是临时编造的借口，毕竟这也太巧合了些。
“算了！走就走吧。”
“听刘知虎的语气，银河谷竟然是在宗门内部，枯血老怪的任务到现在也没有半点进展，此番回到宗门，或许会有所转机也不一定呢……”
想到此处，韩林便开始收拾了起来。
他的识海深处，隐藏着一枚血色符文，他曾经不小心触碰到，那符文立刻释放出无数血红色剑气，让他痛不欲生。
韩林料想，那便是枯血老人留下的法咒。
也曾想过推进一下血灵碗进度，但奈何，青龙河的杂役层次太低，根本不了解宗门内部事情。
即便他再着急，也没有办法。
现在看来，此番去银河谷，也未必不是一件好事情。
片刻后，韩林收拾妥当，背着一个不大的包裹，锁上房门，朝广场方向走去。
来到广场入口处，远远就看到刘知虎的屋门外，站着一群人。
赵锐凌，岳青山，曾平，还有两个二十多岁的青年，韩林虽然看到过，但叫不出名字。
“果然是这赵锐凌在搞鬼。”
当看到赵锐凌的一瞬间，韩林心头跟明镜似的：“这家伙，依旧是贼心不死啊。”
“就是不知道，这次又憋了什么阴招。”韩林目光轻轻闪动着，朝几人走去。
见着韩林过来，两名青年顿时大感意外，窃窃私语。
赵锐凌则怀抱着双手，神色平静地望着刘知虎石屋大门，仿佛没看到韩林一般。
倒是岳青山，脸上满是讥讽之色。

这时，刘知虎从石屋内走了出来，扫视众人一眼：“看来人都到齐了，你们跟我来吧，我亲自送你们去银河谷。”
说罢，走下石阶，朝营地外走去。
……
归元山脉方圆数百里，其中支脉繁多，峰林交错，整体可分为南境和北境两个区域。
北境为宗门高层修行之地，据说只有达到筑基，或者被筑基强者收为弟子之人才能涉足。
而南境，则是普通弟子居住修行的地方，这里人口众多，占了宗门总人数的八成以上。
又因为每年都有杂役弟子转正，洞府不太够用，所以几乎每年，都在为正式弟子建造洞府。
而银河谷，便是今年的建造规划。
参与之人向来都是宗门杂役弟子，而今年的总负责人，则是宗门功德堂的执事，孔鹤。
这天，三月十二。
银河谷开工已经十多天了，但进度着实有点慢，整个银河谷看起来依旧是荒芜一片。
傍晚黄昏，孔鹤站在营地广场上眉头紧锁，忽然一群人影从营地大门走了进来。
孔鹤一愣，快步走上去：“刘师弟？”
刘知虎哈哈一笑：“孔师兄，好久不见了啊，听说你这里缺人手，所以特意给你送人过来了。”
“好，太好了！”
孔鹤神色一喜，目光从韩林等人身上扫过，当接触到韩林面颊时，不经意地皱了皱眉头。
不过并未多说什么。
依旧笑呵呵对刘知虎道：“刘师弟可真是解了我的燃眉之急啊，太感谢你了。”
content_en:
"Something's wrong. It's fine. They transferred me suddenly, and at the very moment when I just offended Zhao Ruiling..."
After Liu Zhihu left, Han Lin stood in the stone house and frowned. His intuition told him that there was something wrong here.
As for the reason Liu Zhihu said, in his opinion, it was more like a temporary excuse. After all, it was too coincidental.
"Forget it! Just leave."
"Listening to Liu Zhihu's tone, Galaxy Valley is actually within the sect. The mission of the withered-blooded old monster has not made any progress so far. It may not be certain that things will turn around when we return to the sect this time..."
Thinking of this, Han Lin started to pack up.
There was a blood-red rune hidden in the depths of his sea of ​​consciousness. He once accidentally touched it, and the rune immediately released countless blood-red sword energy, making him miserable.
Han Lin guessed that it was the spell left by the withered old man.
I also thought about advancing the progress of the Blood Spirit Bowl, but unfortunately, the level of the handymen in Qinglonghe was too low and they did not understand the internal affairs of the sect at all.
No matter how anxious he was, there was nothing he could do.
Now it seems that going to Galaxy Valley this time may not be a bad thing.
After a while, Han Lin packed up, carried a small package, locked the door, and walked towards the square.
When I arrived at the entrance of the square, I saw a group of people standing outside Liu Zhihu's house from a distance.
Although Han Lin had seen Zhao Ruiling, Yue Qingshan, Zeng Ping, and two young men in their twenties, he couldn't name them.
"Sure enough, it's Zhao Ruiling who's up to something."
The moment he saw Zhao Ruiling, Han Lin felt like a mirror: "This guy is still evil."
"I just don't know what kind of dirty trick he has been holding back this time." Han Lin's eyes flickered slightly and he walked towards a few people.
Seeing Han Lin coming over, the two young men were suddenly surprised and whispered.
Zhao Ruiling held his hands in his arms and looked at the door of Liu Zhihu's stone house calmly, as if he had not seen Han Lin.
Yue Qingshan, on the other hand, had a sarcastic look on his face.
At this time, Liu Zhihu walked out of the stone house and glanced at everyone: "It seems that everyone is here. Come with me. I will personally take you to Galaxy Valley."
After that, he walked down the stone steps and walked out of the camp.
…
The Guiyuan Mountain Range covers a radius of hundreds of miles, with many branches and intertwined peaks and forests. The whole mountain can be divided into two areas, the southern and northern areas.
The Northern Territory is the place where high-level sects practice their cultivation. It is said that only those who have reached the foundation building level or are accepted as disciples by a strong foundation building person can set foot in it.
The southern border is where ordinary disciples live and practice. It has a large population, accounting for more than 80% of the total number of people in the sect.
And because the handyman disciples become full-time disciples every year, the caves are not enough, so almost every year, caves are built for the formal disciples.
The Galaxy Valley is this year’s construction plan.
The participants have always been disciples of the sect's handymen, but this year the person in charge is Kong He, the deacon of the sect's Merit Hall.
Today is March 12th.
It has been more than ten days since the construction of Galaxy Valley started, but the progress is really slow, and the entire Galaxy Valley still looks deserted.
In the evening and dusk, Kong He stood in the camp square with a frown on his face. Suddenly, a group of figures walked in from the camp gate.
Kong He was stunned and walked up quickly: "Junior Brother Liu?"
Liu Zhihu laughed: "Senior Brother Kong, I haven't seen you for a long time. I heard that you are short of manpower here, so I specially sent someone here for you."
"Okay, great!"
Kong He looked happy and glanced over Han Lin and others. When he touched Han Lin's cheek, he frowned inadvertently.
But he didn't say much.
Still smiling, he said to Liu Zhihu: "Junior Brother Liu really solved my urgent need. Thank you very much."
